resources.string: The terminal runs in Termux, a separate app with git, ssh, python, node and more. Install it from F-Droid or GitHub (the Play Store version is outdated), then tap Terminal again.

One-time setup:
1. Tap \"Copy & open Termux\", long-press in Termux, paste, press Enter. It enables external apps, asks for storage access (allow it) and installs git, openssh, curl, nano, python and nodejs. 2. Allow \"Run commands in Termux environment\" for Kodex (App info → Permissions) if you denied it. 3. In Android settings, allow Termux \"Display over other apps\".
Then tap Terminal again.
Output appears when the command finishes. No keyboard input: use Terminal for interactive programs.
Kodex opens its terminal in Termux. Set it up once here: check the connection, pick what to install, and Kodex runs it for you in Termux.
